glosses: A person who hoards money rather than spending it; one who is cheap or extremely parsimonious.

examples.text: Scrooge was a typical miser: spending nothing he could save, nor enjoying his wealth.

[…] foꝛ it was many times notoꝛious vnto al mẽ, yͭ he did eate in his houſe no other fleſh by the ſpace of iii. dayes, but on Hare, whiche was ſent him.
